title: LibraryManifest
description: Public student library manifest (library/<folder>/manifest.json). One entry per document of the folder, sorted by local_file. The repositories and the student archive carry no PDF (links only): the application opens the local copy when it is present and matches sha256, otherwise primary_url. Bibliographic fields only: no other property is allowed.

reference.description: Document number or part number as printed by the publisher.

revision.description: Revision label as printed by the publisher.

primary_url.description: Publisher download URL; null when not recorded.

local_file.description: Name of the optional local copy, relative to the manifest folder (never committed).
